name: Sika Set-1 GV
paste:
SIKA® SET-1 GV: SPECIFICATION CLAUSE SET

Source: Sika® Set-1 GV, April 2026, Version 02.02 (https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/v/sika-set-1-gv.pdf)
Draft for specifier review. Wording, values and standards are quoted from that data sheet; where it is silent the clause says 'Refer to manufacturer.' Confirm the current edition before issue.

1 SCOPE
1.1 Work included. Provide Sika® Set-1 GV where documented, installed or applied in accordance with this clause and the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2026, Version 02.02).
1.2 Product description.
    - Sika® Set-1 GV is a set and hardening accelerating admixture for cement / bentonite injection grouts commonly used in backfilling operations during tunnels excavations with shield EPB or shield TBM.
    - Sika® Set-1 GV is supplied in liquid form and is added via a separate hose to injection grouts immediately before the injection point (double component system).
    - It gives a strong acceleration of setting time of the grout thus allowing the hardening of an injected mix even if it has been retarded for 24 - 72 hours by means of the Sika® SikaTard® or Retarder admixture system.
1.3 Intended uses stated by the manufacturer.
    - Sika® Set-1 GV is normally used in tunnel excavation with shield EPB or TBM.The shield during progression leaves an empty ring space between concrete lining and the excavated soil. Injection and filling of this space is commonly done with a cement or cement/ bentonite grout that is stabilized by Sika® set retarding or hydration stabiliser admixture.
    - The re-activation of setting properties is done by adding Sika® Set-1 GV and depending on the dosage used is shortened down to few seconds or few minutes.
1.4 Limits of use. Observe the manufacturer's limitations stated in clause 4.3.

2 MATERIALS
2.1 Product. Sika® Set-1 GV
    - Product type as printed on the data sheet: Set accelerating admixture for two component injection grout
    - Supplier as printed on the data sheet: Sika Australia Pty Limited, ABN 12 001 342 329, aus.sika.com, Tel: 1300 22 33 48
2.2 Approvals, certificates and standards stated by the manufacturer. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2026, Version 02.02) has no approvals, certificates or standards section.
2.3 Characteristics stated by the manufacturer. Sika® Set-1 GV has the following characteristics:
    - Ensures a controlled hardening of injected grout
    - Allows perfect pumpability of retarded and stabilized grout
    - Stops the down flow of injected grout thus avoiding loss of material
    - Ensures good mechanical strengths (comparable to ground strengths)
    - Ensure full hydration of cement
    - Stops segregation and bleeding after injection
2.4 Composition, appearance and supply.
    - Composition: Silicate based
    - Appearance and colour: Clear to cloudy liquid.
    - Density: ~ 1.38 kg/l (at 20 °C)
    - pH-Value: 11 - 13
    - Viscosity: 100-300 cP at 20° C
2.5 Packaging, shelf life and storage.
    - Packaging: Bulk supply
    - Shelf life: 12 months if stored properly
    - Storage conditions: Store in cool and dry conditions in unopened, undamaged and sealed original packaging at temperatures between +5 °C and +40 °C protected from direct sunlight.

3 SUBSTRATE PREPARATION
3.1 Substrate preparation. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2026, Version 02.02) states no substrate preparation requirements.

4 APPLICATION
4.1 General. Apply in accordance with the manufacturer's Product Data Sheet (April 2026, Version 02.02) and the requirements below.
4.2 Application data.
    - Recommended dosage: Typical dosage range of Sika® Set-1 GV is 5–25 % by weight of cement. Pre-trials to confirm the actual required dosage for the materials and mix design in use must be done by the user.
4.3 Limitations and important considerations.
    - Addition of Sika® Set-1 GV is through a special injector that pushes the admixture into the grout flow hoses. Sika® Set-1 GV must only be added to cement grout immediately before injection of the grout.
    - To evaluate setting time jobsite and laboratory trials are recommended.

5 QUALITY CONTROL AND TESTING
5.1 Hold point. Before each application, confirm the site conditions with the manufacturer. HOLD POINT: do not proceed until the Superintendent has released the hold point.
5.2 Conditions to be verified. Refer to manufacturer. The data sheet reviewed (April 2026, Version 02.02) lists no application condition limits.
5.3 Basis of the stated values. All technical data stated in this Product Data Sheet are based on laboratory tests. Actual measured data may vary due to circumstances beyond our control.
5.4 Other tests. For any test method, sampling frequency or acceptance criterion not stated in this clause: refer to manufacturer and the project specification.

6 WARRANTY AND DOCUMENTATION
6.1 Documents to be obtained and submitted. Obtain the current issue of each document before ordering and submit it with the product submission. Documents are listed as published on the manufacturer's website.
    - Product Data Sheet: Sika® Set-1 GV, April 2026, Version 02.02, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/v/sika-set-1-gv.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SikaSet 1 GV, version 22/07/2025, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/2/MSDS%20SikaSet%C2%AE-1%20GV%20GHS7.pdf
    - Safety Data Sheet: SDS SikaSet®-1 GV, version 06/03/2026, https://aus.sika.com/content/dam/dms/au01/t/sds-sikaset-1-gv.pdf
6.2 Ecology, health and safety. For information and advice on the safe handling, storage and disposal of chemical products, users shall refer to the most recent Material Safety Data Sheet containing physical, ecological, toxicological and other safety-related data.
6.3 Warranty. Obtain any product or installation warranty in writing from the manufacturer or its authorised applicator and file it with the project records. Warranty terms: refer to manufacturer.
    - Legal notes: In practice, the differences in materials, substrates and actual site conditions are such that no warranty in respect of merchantability or of fitness for a particular purpose, nor any liability arising out of any legal relationship whatsoever, can be inferred either from this information, or from any written recommendations, or from any other advice offered.
6.4 Local restrictions. Please note that as a result of specific local regulations the declared data for this product may vary from country to country. Please consult the local Product Data Sheet for the exact product data.
6.5 Application records. Record the product name, batch numbers, dates, areas treated and the conditions measured under clause 5.1, and include the records in the project documentation.
